# P31.6 (DEEPEN.2): access-edge claims + asserting replay + hosted edge/link materialization

Implements `docs/tickets/P31.6__access-edges-and-hosted-link-materialization.md` (Round 9 Wave B, manifest
row 147). Live-verified (`live_verification=true`): hosted replay from persisted capture bytes, the two
affected live jobs rolled on a digest-pinned image, and both materializers run on the hosted spine with >0
inserts and +0 re-runs. Closes **D-P30.2-2** and **D-P31.5-1**; leaves **D-P31.5-2** and **D-P30.2a-1** OPEN
(P31.16 / P31.8). Stacked on the P31.5 tip `devin/p31-5-entity-ref-claims-procurement`. ADR-113 is the
design's `ADR-R9-REPLAY`.

## Summary

- **`configured_access_edge` records become claims.** `flock_portal` and `audit_structural` now emit ordinary
  `record_kind="claim"` rows under the new registered predicate `configured_sharing_partner` (directed
  subject → partner), preserving `from_org`/`to_org`, `access_kind`, `valid_from_kind`/`valid_to_kind`, the raw
  literal value, and the provenance fields. `index_only`/`research_task` records are unchanged.
- **Deterministic entity refs, differing honestly by emitter** (P31.5's `link()` seam):
  - flock_portal partner values are platform *slugs* — the ref is `sig.connector.subject` /
    `flock_portal:<slug>` typed `deployment`, the same key the partner's own portal subject carries;
  - audit_structural partner values are organisation *names* — routed through
    `resolution.partner_identity`: accepted names get `sig.org.name` org refs; refused (generic,
    ambiguous, person-shaped, single-word) names stay literal claims and are never coerced into edges;
  - `eff_data_driven` emits a `vendor` claim per agency aggregate plus a `configured_sharing_partner`
    claim for `pooled_lookup_participant` rows (the NVLS pooled-lookup pool, endpoint = the release's
    single vendor constant), both with `partner_ref_rows` twins; the aggregate-only /
    no-per-search-row design is unchanged.
- **Ontology:** `configured_sharing_partner` (multi-cardinality, entity_ref, maps to
  `configured-sharing-partner set`) and `vendor` (entity_ref) registered; `make gen` artifacts committed;
  `PARTNER_PREDICATES` updated to match.
- **Asserting replay is a new, separate path** (ADR-113): `connectors.replay.replay()` stays
  non-asserting and network-isolated. `runner.replay_ingest` + `sig-ops replay-ingest` select persisted
  `ingest_run_capture` marks, resolve OCFL capture bytes, run connector post-capture stages with target
  metadata supplied, and assert through a fresh `is_replay=true` `PgClaimSink` run carrying
  `replay_source`/`replay_of_runs` lineage and `replay:`-prefixed capture marks. A digest absent from the
  store is recorded `missing`/partial and **never re-fetched**. Reruns dedupe by claim content (+0).
- **`PgClaimSink`** gains `extra_parameters` (merged into `ingest_run.parameters`, sink-owned keys
  cannot be shadowed); the sink stays append-only, identity-guarded, idempotent.
- **Nothing is republished.** Public edges/links remain owed to P31.16 (HG-11).
